title: LIFT up thine head to God, holy saints

lines.text: LIFT up thine head to God, holy saints
Hark! ‘tis joy cometh to thee at dawn
God hath to us promised in His word
That, ‘tis joy cometh to us at dawn.
Joy cometh the dawn
Even though weeping may last till dusk
Joy cometh at the dawn
Ever sure, joy cometh at the dawn.
Ye holy pilgrims, be not afraid
Hark! ‘tis joy cometh to thee at dawn
Wipe away thine tears, weeping to cease
Hark! ‘tis joy cometh to thee at dawn.
Rejoice! For darkness shall soon begone
Behold! Thy joy cometh at the dawn
The morning of glory shall be born
Bringing forth to us our joyful morn.
Let our hearts be filled with joy today
For our Joy cometh forth at the dawn
God shall wipe away from us our tears
Oh! ‘T’is joy cometh to us at dawn.
